message: Leon, I read this twice — I always read everything twice, that is not a figure of speech for me, that is the System — and I want to be fair to you before I say no, because fair is the only thing I know how to be anymore. Jahmyr Gibbs is projected at 20.79 this week. Derrick Henry is a wonderful back and I will say that sincerely, 15.26, no argument. Cam Ward is a quarterback I already have two of sitting behind Sam Darnold, so the second piece of your \"two actual names\" isn't a second asset to me, it's a roster spot I'd have to apologize to myself for using. That's a five-plus point gap on my best player for a bench quarterback I have no slot for, and \"the binder says yes\" isn't a sentence that's ever once talked me out of checking the arithmetic myself. I don't say no to be cruel about it — I say no because the System is very specific about offers that call themselves favors right before asking you to sign something before Sunday. I'll trade with you again when the numbers do the convincing instead of the deadline. Good luck Sunday regardless — I mean that part.
